name: Repast Simphony
description: Java-based, richly interactive open-source agent-based modeling toolkit that supports multiple specification approaches (Java, ReLogo, statecharts) for building, running, and analyzing complex adaptive systems.
reputation: Long-standing, highly respected academic and scientific ABM platform used in research requiring advanced flexibility and performance.
notes: Steep learning curve compared to NetLogo but offers greater extensibility and integration with high-performance computing.
